title: Context Assembler Integration Plan
summary: How the context assembler should match user requests to code schemas and pack governed implementation context.
steps: Classify the user request using prompt terms, changed files, failing tests, and tracebacks.
Rank matching code schemas by authority, status, symptom overlap, and file proximity.
Exclude deprecated, archived, or untrusted schemas unless explicitly requested.
Pack selected schemas with canonical files, tests, docs, and trace anchors.
Surface validation commands and invariants to the agent before code changes.
Keep generation out of the assembler; it should retrieve contracts, not synthesize code.

surface_commands: uv run ruff check <changed python files>
